title: Feather Float
instructions: Keep a lightweight object (feather, paper) in the air using only breaths for 15 seconds.

title: Whisper Chain
instructions: Whisper a word to the next player; after the chain, reveal whether the final word matches the original.

title: Breeze Pattern
instructions: Create a simple body movement pattern timed to 8 beats and repeat it in unison twice.

title: Kite Words
instructions: Each player says a single word to build a short sentence in order; it must be grammatically correct.

title: Gale Relay
instructions: Relay a soft ball across the room using only throws underhand; complete within 25 seconds without dropping.

title: Wind Story
instructions: Tell a coherent story where each player speaks for exactly 5 seconds; maintain narrative flow for at least 6 players.
